title: UniCorrn: Unified Correspondence Transformer Across 2D and 3D
summary: A unified transformer model developed by Adobe Research and Northeastern University that performs 2D-2D, 2D-3D, and 3D-3D matching tasks within a single architecture. It uses shared weights and a dual-stream attention mechanism to achieve state-of-the-art results in geometric correspondence.
research_notes: Introduces a novel dual-stream attention decoder that handles appearance and positional features separately while sharing core weights; presented at CVPR 2026.

evolution.summary: As of mid-2026, UniCorrn represents the current state-of-the-art in unified cross-modal matching, merging previously separate image and point cloud registration tasks into one foundation model framework.
